summary: Alset Inc. reported in an 8-K that on September 15, 2026 it entered a securities purchase agreement with related party DSS, Inc., acquiring for $500,000 a demand convertible promissory note bearing 3% simple interest and warrants for 8,000,000 DSS shares. Note principal and interest convert at $0.50 per share; warrants strike $0.55 and expire in five years. Alset already holds roughly 39.4% of DSS, and both entities share Chairman/CEO Chan Heng Fai. DSS stockholder approval is required before conversion or exercise.
